title: FairMask: Better Fairness via Model-based Rebalancing of Protected Attributes
benchmark_measurement: The paper cites a prior work example where a sentiment analysis model was evaluated for bias against Jewish attributes.
findings: The paper does not present new findings on religion. It mentions a finding from prior work where a Google sentiment analysis model was observed to assign negative scores to Jewish attributes in sentences.
